lastTask: Implement Byte L2 read-only graphical phrase editor

projectState.summary: Byte L2 is implemented on codex/byte-l2-readonly-graphical-editor. The melody player card opens a default-closed read-only graphical editor overlay outside the Inspect drawer, rendering the current song's window.anchorPhrase.fromProsody() native phrase as an SVG roll with bar/beat grid, degree-colored anchors, connector labels, and a visible breath. Close, Escape, and backdrop dismiss it without touching transport. Visual capture confirmed 11 anchors, 9 connectors, 1 breath, and stopped transport. Validation: build green, smoke 71/71, db:smoke green, diff-check green, npm audit unchanged with known Vite/esbuild advisories.
